title: FineWeb-CLaR: Culture, Language, and Region Annotations for Benchmark-Aligned Corpus Auditing

bias_targets.methodology: Mapping corpus documents to a 14-leaf Cultural Taxonomy using multilingual topic modeling and LLM adjudication, and comparing these corpus-side topic distributions against the cultural phenomena targeted by 277 NLP benchmarks to identify representational blind spots.

Attributing web documents to geographic regions using URL-derived ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 labels, and quantifying document mass across macro-regions and locales to uncover geographic underrepresentation in pretraining data.

Comparing corpus evidence and cultural topic distributions across different languages and measuring within-language regional divergence (e.g., comparing cultural topics in Egyptian Arabic vs. Moroccan Arabic) using Jensen-Shannon distance.
